title: Your Heart When You Sit All Day
description:
Many adults spend more than 7 hours a day sitting down. Sitting or lying down for long periods is thought to increase the risk of long-term conditions such as heart disease, stroke and type 2 diabetes, and you can hit your weekly activity target but still be at risk if you spend the rest of the time sitting. The NHS advises adults to reduce time spent sitting or lying down and to break up long periods of not moving with some activity.

Educational only. Not medical advice.
setting: bright modern home office with a wooden desk and a big window, soft daylight, teal walls and warm wood tones, bokeh

heart.name: heart
heart.look: cute cartoon heart mascot, glossy coral-red smooth rounded valentine-heart-shaped body with no tubes or vessels on top, big cartoon eyes and mouth, tiny arms and legs

chair.name: office chair
chair.look: cute cartoon office chair mascot, plush charcoal-grey cushioned seat and backrest with a cartoon face on the backrest, padded armrests as its arms, five-wheeled base

trainer.name: running shoe
trainer.look: cute cartoon running shoe mascot, bright white and teal trainer with a cartoon face on the toe, laces like a tuft of hair, tiny arms

scenes.speaker: heart
scenes.image: tired slumped heart mascot sinking into the plush office chair mascot at a desk with a laptop, droopy half-closed eyes
scenes.motion: the heart slumps lower in the chair and sighs, eyelids drooping
scenes.narration: Nine hours at my desk. Not one break.

scenes.speaker: chair
scenes.image: smug office chair mascot with a sly grin, close-up
scenes.motion: the chair grins and swivels slightly, its cushion puffing up invitingly
scenes.narration: Stay seated. You're so comfy here.

scenes.speaker: trainer
scenes.image: energetic running shoe mascot hopping onto the desk with a raised eyebrow
scenes.motion: the shoe lands with a bounce and raises an eyebrow, laces bouncing
scenes.narration: Hey! When did you last stand up?

scenes.speaker: heart
scenes.image: embarrassed heart mascot sitting in the office chair, scratching its head with a sheepish grin
scenes.motion: the heart scratches its head and looks away sheepishly

scenes.speaker: trainer
scenes.image: running shoe mascot explaining with one hand raised, standing on the wooden desk, close-up
scenes.motion: the shoe gestures with its hand while explaining, laces swaying
scenes.narration: Many adults sit for more than 7 hours a day.

scenes.speaker: trainer
scenes.image: serious running shoe mascot pointing upwards with a concerned frown, close-up
scenes.motion: the shoe frowns and points as it explains, leaning forward
scenes.narration: Long spells of sitting are thought to raise the risk of heart disease, stroke and type 2 diabetes.

scenes.speaker: heart
scenes.image: shocked heart mascot with wide eyes and open mouth gripping the armrests of the office chair
scenes.motion: the heart jolts upright in shock, eyes widening
scenes.narration: Heart disease?! But I go to the gym!

scenes.speaker: trainer
scenes.image: running shoe mascot giving a thumbs up with a kind smile, close-up
scenes.motion: the shoe gives a thumbs up, then wags a finger gently
scenes.narration: Great! But you can still be at risk if you sit the rest of the time.

scenes.speaker: trainer
scenes.image: running shoe mascot jogging on the spot beside the desk, cheerful, sunlight from the window
scenes.motion: the shoe jogs on the spot and stretches its tiny arms up
scenes.narration: So break up long sits. Stand, stretch, walk around.

scenes.speaker: heart
scenes.image: happy heart mascot standing up and stretching its arms beside the empty office chair mascot, which looks sad
scenes.motion: the heart stands up and stretches happily as the chair droops
scenes.narration: Up I get! See you later, chair.
